concerns.text: Tasks T054 (Outlier Sensitivity), T055 (Power Analysis Refinement), and T056 (Non-Linearity Check) in Phase 9 have no corresponding Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC) in spec.md. The spec mandates Bonferroni correction (FR-006) and standard power analysis (FR-007), but does not authorize Jackknife resampling, Monte Carlo simulation, or polynomial regression. These tasks represent unapproved scope expansion without a spec anchor.

Task T000 (DataAudit) and T013 (RealDataLoader) explicitly state 'Do NOT query OpenKim/Materials Cloud APIs' and rely solely on local file checks. While the plan.md justifies this as a 'Synthetic Override', the spec.md FR-001 explicitly requires the system to 'download and parse MD snapshot files from the specified public repositories'. There is no task that attempts the download or formally documents the failure of the external source as a prerequisite for switching to synthetic mode, leaving FR-001 unimplemented in the task list.

Task T047 (ReportGenerator) aggregates results but lacks a specific sub-task to generate a formal 'null hypothesis test report' or visualize the null distribution (e.g., permutation test) as required by SC-001 ('measured against the null hypothesis of zero correlation'). The current tasks cover correlation calculation (T028) and visualization (T033/T034) but miss the explicit artifact generation for the null hypothesis verification step defined in SC-001.
